DECLARE @MINCLAIMSTARTDATE AS VARCHAR(20)
DECLARE @ENV AS VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @ABDIAGQUERY AS VARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @JobId INT

SET @ENV = (SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(VALUE,'DEV') FROM EPSDTAPPCONFIG WHERE CONFIGKEY = 'ENVIRONMENT')
SET @MINCLAIMSTARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY, -121, GETDATE())
SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'SystemRefresh')

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Refresh AbDiagRef', 0, 0

TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTAbDiagLoad
TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTEdinetReferralClaims
TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTEdinetReferralLoad
TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTAbDiagReferral

select @MINCLAIMSTARTDATE  --, AbDiagQuery = @AbDiagQuery

EXEC DATA_EXCHANGE.[EPSDT].[PR_EPSDTRefreshAbDiagRef_Stp2EdinetFromODW] ?     WITH RESULT SETS      ( (  agpClmNbr                   bigint NOT NULL        , EPSDTCondInd	           [varchar](2) NOT NULL         )       )

EXEC DATA_EXCHANGE.[EPSDT].[PR_EPSDTRefreshAbDiagRef_Stp3CDMLtoRefStg] ?     WITH RESULT SETS      ( (  [ClaimNumber] [varchar](20) NULL, 	[ServiceLineNbr] [smallint] NOT NULL, 	[ServiceDate] [datetime] NULL, 	[ClaimRcvdDate] [datetime] NULL, 	[Market] [varchar](10) NULL, 	[MemberID] [varchar](26) NOT NULL, 	[MemberName] [varchar](71) NULL, 	[MemberBirthDate] [datetime] NULL, 	[MemberGender] [varchar](5) NULL, 	[ProviderID] [varchar](20) NOT NULL, 	[ProviderName] [varchar](72) NULL, 	[ProcedureCd] [varchar](8) NULL, 	[DiagSeqNbr] [decimal](3, 0) NOT NULL, 	[DiagType] [varchar](5) NOT NULL, 	[DiagCode] [varchar](11) NULL, 	[DiagDescription] [varchar](228) NULL, 	[ReferralCode] [char](2) NOT NULL         )       )

varAbDiagQuery.defaultValue:
'USE DATA_EXCHANGE  
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

SELECT
	 ClaimNumber		= C.CLCL_ID
	,ServiceLineNbr		= CL.[CDML_SEQ_NO] 
	,ClaimSeqNbr		= '0'
	,ServiceDate		= CL.[CDML_FROM_DT]
	,ClaimRcvdDate		= C.[CLCL_RECD_DT] 
	,Market				= MKT.IR_CODESET_CD   
	,MemberID			= SBSB_ID + '00'
	,MemberName			= MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME + ' ' + MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME 
	,MemberBirthDate	= CONVERT (CHAR(10),MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,101)
	,MemberGender		= MEME.MEME_SEX 
	,ProviderID			= P.PRPR_ID
	,ProviderName		= P.PRPR_NAME  
	,ProcedureCd		= CL.IPCD_ID
	,DiagSeqNbr			= ISNULL (CL.[CDML_SEQ_NO],1)
	,DiagType			= ISNULL (IDC.IDCD_TYPE,'T')
	,DiagCode			= IDC.IDCD_ID
	,DiagDescription	= IDC.IDCD_DESC

FROM (SELECT CLCL_ID, GRGR_CK, MEME_CK, CDML_SEQ_NO, CDML_FROM_DT, CL.IPCD_ID,IPCD_DESC,IPCD_TYPE, PRPR_ID, [IDCD_ID]
        FROM (SELECT [IPCD_ID],[IPCD_DESC],[IPCD_TYPE], [IPCD_EFF_DT] , [IPCD_TERM_DT]
					FROM [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_IPCD_PROC_CD] 
					  WHERE (IPCD_ID BETWEEN '99381' AND '99385' OR IPCD_ID BETWEEN '99391' AND '99395'))IPCD
 INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CDML_CL_LINE CL 
         ON CL.IPCD_ID = IPCD.IPCD_ID 
	     AND CL.[CDML_FROM_DT] > DATEADD(DAY, -121, GETDATE())
		 AND CL.[CDML_FROM_DT] BETWEEN [IPCD_EFF_DT] AND [IPCD_TERM_DT] 
		 AND CL.GRGR_CK IN (SELECT GRGR_CK FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_GRGR_GROUP WHERE GRGR_ID LIKE '%MCD%') ) CL

INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C  ON C.CLCL_ID = CL.CLCL_ID 	AND C.GRGR_CK = CL.GRGR_CK
INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV P ON CL.PRPR_ID = P.PRPR_ID
INNER JOIN (SELECT IDCD.IDCD_ID , IDCD.IDCD_DESC , IDCD.IDCD_TYPE    
	                        FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_IDCD_DIAG_CD IDCD
                             WHERE IDCD.IDCD_TERM_DT >= GETDATE ()
                              AND IDCD.IDCD_ID NOT IN ('V20','V200','V201','V202','V700','V703','V704','V705','V706','V707','V708','V709','V720','V721','V0381','V048','V0382','V061','V065','V064','V068','V040','V054','V741','V825')
			 
			) IDC 
		 ON IDC.IDCD_ID = CL.IDCD_ID 

INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME  ON MEME.MEME_CK = C.MEME_CK  
INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB   ON  MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND MEME.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
INNER JOIN  ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE  ON MEME.GRGR_CK = MEPE.GRGR_CK  AND MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK 
										       AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
											   AND  MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < GETDATE() AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT >= GETDATE() --this returns current members only
LEFT JOIN (SELECT  GRGR_CK, CSCS_ID = RIGHT ([SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD],4), [CODESET_CD] ,[SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD],[IR_CODESET_CD],[CODESET_NM],[SRC_SYS_CODESET_VALUE_DESC]
               FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE]  
			     JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_GRGR_GROUP GR on 
				  LEFT (SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD,8) = GR.GRGR_ID 
				WHERE [SRC_SYS_CD] = 'FAC'  AND [CODESET_CD] = 'MRKT'
				) MKT
			   ON MKT.CSCS_ID = MEPE.CSCS_ID
			   AND MKT.GRGR_CK = MEPE.GRGR_CK'
